protocol.default: Replay request steps from protocol-*.session.json and compare the concatenated server messages to protocol-*.ndjson in order, with every field exact unless matched by an allow-list entry with scope protocol.

cli.default: Compare parsed JSON, ignoring object key order. Array order and file sets are exact unless matched by an allow-list entry with scope cli.

renderer.default: Compare renderer-visible-v1.json exactly against its derivation from the frozen transcripts.

differences.reason: The V2 wire contract will be versioned independently; V1 protocol 4 is the comparison baseline.

differences.v1: NDJSON over one persistent Unix domain socket per session
differences.reason: Transport framing remains tentative until ticket 079 decides whether additional transports are supported.
V2 suggestion capability defaults are owned by the V2 server ticket.
V2 config is JSON-first and owned by the packs/defaults contract.

differences.v1: request types/config accepted; response files[].spans and root intents
differences.v2: types removed; options added; files[].annotations and diagnostics; root intents removed
differences.reason: The HTTP facade follows the V2 server contract.
Publication field names and additions are part of the V2 IPC contract.

differences.v1: groups + candidates + analysisRevision + suggestionRevision; flat candidate fields
differences.reason: Candidate publication is replaced by the unified V2 proposal shape.

differences.v2: same flat span plus diagnostics, provenance.ruleId, provenance.packId, optional evidence
differences.reason: V2 adds rule identity and diagnostics without replacing the flat span shape.

differences.v1: source + reason + aiEligible with flat span fields
differences.v2: origin + category + fingerprints + operations + flat span fields
differences.reason: The V2 proposal contract replaces rule/string provenance on candidates.

differences.v1: uri + version + optional requestId; cancel/log by uri/requestId; progress notifications
differences.v2: selection span; stream and history methods; JSON-RPC cancellation; progress in stream
differences.reason: Suggestions move to streaming and span-based selection in V2.

differences.v2: cint/restrictions GET-style plus upsert; scope and condition fields
differences.reason: V2 extends restrictions with scope and conditional application.

differences.v1: HTTP health only; live cint/status is an unknown-method error
differences.v2: HTTP health adds version/uptime/activeDocuments/suggestionQueue; live cint/status and cint/metrics
differences.reason: Status and metrics are added by the V2 server contract.
V2 file layout is owned by the packs/defaults ticket.

differences.v2: per-file annotations and diagnostics; root intents removed; meta added; format selector
differences.reason: The CLI output contract is owned by the V2 CLI ticket.

differences.v1: wire projection of tags, candidates, lifecycle, suggest, restrictions, config and status
differences.v2: operations, confidence percentage, provenance details, restriction scope and streaming progress
differences.reason: Renderer extraction owns the V2 display projection.

differences.v2: standard JSON-RPC codes plus structured data.kind/data.details
differences.reason: Structured errors are part of the V2 IPC contract.

differences.v2: same launch set plus planned python, go, rust
differences.reason: Language facade ownership is defined by the V2 languages ticket.

differences.v1: optional LSP, silent heuristic fallback, corpus captured with --no-lsp
differences.v2: required for type-dependent intents, explicit diagnostics, cached type facts
differences.reason: LSP behavior is owned by the V2 LSP provider ticket.

differences.v1: full re-analyze on change; sequential suggestions
differences.v2: incremental analysis and parallel suggestion targets
differences.reason: Performance targets are validated by the V2 parity integration ticket.
